title: Road closures update from County Roads: Olesons and East Middle School access
dek: Here is the latest from County Roads. Olesons, along with East Middle School, are only accessible from Hammond Rd east of Three Mile. (Shared Road Commission update: Hammond Road East to Three Mile Road North is now passable; Hammond Road is closed between Townline Road to just West of Three Mile Road; Three Mile Road is CLOSED.)

title: Power out in part of Traverse City after vehicle accident; Sixth and Spruce shut down
dek: Posted Aug 11, 2026 at 5:02 PM: Power is out in the below area of the City of Traverse City due to a vehicle accident, TCLP is on scene now working to fix the problem. As a result the area of Sixth and Spruce will be shut down until it is repaired.
